items.title: Evan Christopher interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 1, 2009
items.q: the first solos that I ever transcribed were clarinet solos and one of them was Johnny Dodds “Struttin’ with some Barbeque” with Louis Armstrong’s Hot Five

ctx.x: I was surprised at how quickly I found a community of peers, young guys, some definitely were younger than me, some guys a few years older than me, that could sit around a restaurant at breakfast and talk about CDs we just bought and stuff like that, and, “Oh you got the new Louis Armstrong box set?” So I think that there’s a level of community that surprised me, there was a level of acceptance that was a little disarming and I still don’t know what to do with that aspect of it.
Were those people that were so accepting of you all natives?
